reading.text: There is a small bakery on our street. The baker gets up at four o'clock to bake bread. By seven o'clock the fresh bread is on the shelves. I often buy a loaf on my way to school. At lunchtime I make a cheese sandwich with two slices of white bread. My best friend prefers brown bread. We eat our sandwiches together in the garden.

reading.title: A Surprise Cake
reading.text: Yesterday was my mother's birthday. My sister and I wanted to surprise her, so we baked a chocolate cake in the afternoon. It was not easy! The cake was a little flat, but it tasted wonderful. We put ten candles on top. After dinner, Dad cut the cake and everyone had a piece. Mum was so happy that she cried. Then she opened a tin of biscuits and we ate those too.

reading.title: Potato Day
reading.text: Every autumn my uncle has a potato day on his farm. He grows potatoes all year, and in October we dig them up. Each of us fills a sack of potatoes. In the evening Aunt peels some, and we eat mashed potatoes and roast potatoes. Dad makes chips too, and my little cousin eats a huge portion. The potatoes taste better when you grow them yourself.

reading.title: The Salty Soup
reading.text: Yesterday I cooked soup for my family for the first time. I chopped the vegetables and boiled them in water. Then I added salt, but I added too much! When my father tasted the soup, he made a funny face. It was very salty. Mum said, "Next time, just add a pinch of salt and taste it first." We drank a lot of water that evening, and we all laughed.
